# Aqademiq — AI-Powered Student Productivity Hub
# https://aqademiq.com
# Last updated: 2026-06-25

## About
Aqademiq is an AI-powered academic planning and productivity platform designed for students. Aqademiq is a product of R13 Labs India Private Limited. Built on procrastination psychology research, it helps students overcome decision fatigue, task overwhelm, and poor planning — the real drivers of procrastination. Aqademiq features an AI study coach named Ada that creates personalized weekly study plans, breaks large projects into micro-tasks, and adapts in real-time to student progress.

## Key Differentiators
- Built on behavioral psychology and procrastination research
- ADHD-friendly and neurodivergent-accessible by design
- AI study coach (Ada) that personalizes plans in real-time
- Sensory-friendly modes, low-distraction layouts, adaptive notifications
- 5-minute setup, full semester coverage
- Integrates with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and university LMS systems

## Target Users
- College and university students
- Students with ADHD or neurodivergent conditions
- Students struggling with procrastination or time management
- Anyone seeking AI-assisted academic planning

## FAQ

Q: Is Aqademiq designed for ADHD or neurodivergent students?
A: Aqademiq is designed for all students, with specific accessibility features neurodivergent students find invaluable: sensory-friendly modes, low-distraction layouts, adaptive notifications, and clear step-by-step planning. ADHD students especially benefit from Ada's micro-task breakdown and reduced decision paralysis.

Q: How does Aqademiq actually reduce procrastination?
A: Procrastination research shows it's often driven by decision fatigue, task overwhelm, or poor planning — not laziness. Aqademiq addresses all three: Ada breaks big projects into concrete steps, prioritizes your week automatically, and adapts your plan in real-time. Studies show AI-assisted planning reduces procrastination by 30–40%.

Q: How long does it take to set up?
A: Most students finish setup in 3–5 minutes: connect your school, answer 3 quick questions about your study style, and Ada builds your week.

Q: Is the interface sensory-friendly for ADHD or autism?
A: Yes. You can turn off animations, reduce colors, mute notifications, and switch to a simplified layout. Sensory customization is built-in, not an afterthought.

Q: How is this different from other study apps?
A: Most study apps are task managers with a study coat of paint. Aqademiq is built on behavioral psychology and adaptive AI. It doesn't just list what to do; it explains why and when, prevents decision paralysis, and feels designed for how students actually think.

Q: Can I sync my existing calendar and LMS?
A: Absolutely. Aqademiq integrates with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and most university LMS systems. Import your syllabus directly, and Ada automatically creates tasks and deadlines for you.
